claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: GR-103691 is a selective dopamine D3 receptor antagonist with no known cytotoxic or antiproliferative activity, so at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: GR-103691 is a selective dopamine D3 receptor antagonist with no known cytotoxic or antiproliferative activity, so at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines.
